regime.summary: Risk-off, deepening but off the lows: BTC fell from ~68k to a four-month low near 62k over Nov 13-15 on a seventh straight day of spot-ETF outflows, a hot-CPI hangover and continued AI-capex doubt, then rebounded to ~64.8k by this snapshot; Fear & Greed is at 10 (extreme fear, down from 28 a week ago), BTCUSDT sits in v0 cell R9 (liquidation, dir down, vol high), and funding is negative (ann -3.2% predicted, z -1.78) -- shorts paying longs, consistent with a flush rather than fresh conviction. No new network-wide hack, exchange insolvency or regulator action beyond what the feed and a web check turned up (isolated: Kava Lend hack -$3.8M/-40% KAVA Nov 14; Coinone data-breach phishing warning Nov 15). Active narratives in force per research/narratives/STATE.md: inflation_fed (Dec-hike odds re-priced up after the hot Oct CPI print, Nov 10), ai (capex-payback doubt, documented same-day BTC~NVDA co-move ~0.53), and crypto-specific bleed (ETF outflows, CLARITY Act stalled in the lame-duck Senate, stablecoin supply contraction). Per R-NEWS-7/R-NEWS-5, none of the attention/F&G/outflow readings below are used as a direction or next-day-vol call; they are regime and forced-flow context only.

ideas.thesis: Nvidia Q3 FY2027 reports Tue Nov 17 22:00 UTC (2026-W46.yaml, importance 3): next AI-capex test after the Nov 5 selloff (BTC -5.5%, NVDA -10.2% same day). NVDA is #2 in our 24h feed (14); both NVDAUSDT/BTCUSDT sit in v0 cell R9 tonight. A weak guide risks same-session spillover; R-PX-12 caps that co-move to the same hour -- a vol window, not a directional lean.

ARBUSDT's own 24h turnover in this snapshot is ~25.8M USD, i.e. the unlock is roughly a full day's turnover in size -- a real supply-side forced-flow candidate in-universe, though unlock-day price impact is not a tested edge here (data gap).

honesty.base_rate: No idea above calls BTC or ETH direction; R-NEWS-7 and R-NEWS-5 (news attention, F&G level/change, event flags and on-chain activity are neither a direction nor a next-day-vol signal for BTC) apply directly to this report's inputs. A random long or short on any symbol here has no documented edge from these inputs alone.
conflicts: R-NEWS-7: the extreme F&G (10) and the capitulation-toned headlines read as 'the bottom is in' to a human eye but carry no measured direction edge.
R-VOL-28: the put-heavy, above-spot max-pain Deribit skew (idea 2) looks like upside pin pressure but the tested rule found no pinning/release edge even for the larger weekly case.
R-PX-12: the NVDA-BTC co-move (idea 1) is same-hour only; do not extend any reaction past the print window.
R-AVOID-4: none of these events should be read as a session-of-day tilt.
honesty.what_would_change_my_mind: A forward re-run of R-VOL-28/R-NEWS-7 (scripts/news_alt_study.py) showing a holdout Brier or QLIKE skill flip, or a scheduled event this week producing a >2 sigma BTC move that holds past the same-hour window against R-PX-12's finding.
